notes: Rest/congestion (ledger context, PARTIAL; research found ≈ no signal): home rest 3 d, 2 matches in 14 d; away rest 3 d, 2 matches in 14 d.

Head-to-head (international results since 1996-08-31): 2 meetings, home side 0W 0D 2L, goals 1-5.
Model calibration to date (data_only.world_sim_v2.intl_pool, match_result_3way, all horizons): n 807, log loss 0.54164 vs market 0.525, ECE 0.0579, mean CLV -0.0026; authority RESEARCH_ONLY.
International pool model: NOT VALIDATED (docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md #26); projections are RESEARCH.
Every model number here is RESEARCH_ONLY evidence, not a bet.
Settled: 1-1 (regulation); 50 tickers; model Brier 0.05998 vs close-mid Brier 0.09517; mean CLV (yes, points) -0.0055.
